data.title: Add time tracking
data.body:
## Goal

Track time spent on bugs for velocity and estimation purposes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Add `TimeLogged { minutes: u32, note: Option<String> }` event
- [ ] `docket log-time ID MINUTES` logs time spent
- [ ] `docket log-time ID 45 --note "Debugging auth"` with note
- [ ] `docket show ID` displays total time spent
- [ ] `docket list` could show time column (optional)
- [ ] Time derived by summing all TimeLogged events
- [ ] Consider: auto-tracking based on workspace session duration

## Context

Understanding how long bugs take helps with estimation and planning. Currently there's no way to track this systematically.

Auto-tracking idea: `docket work` records start time, `docket done` calculates duration and logs it automatically.

Lower priority: manual time tracking is often inaccurate anyway.
